environment.description: Same application deployed behind CloudFront distribution with Origin Shield enabled (us-east-1 regional edge cache). The distribution has a custom response headers policy (ID: managed-policy-67f89abc) that strips Server-Timing headers from responses. CloudFront's TCP connection pooling and multi-hop routing introduces 8-45ms of non-deterministic latency jitter per request. Additionally, the origin is an ECS Fargate task behind an internal ALB with cross-zone load balancing across 3 AZs, and the ALB has a fixed-response rule returning 429 for any source IP exceeding 50 requests/second (measured via ALB connection tracking). The CSP header is set via CloudFront response headers policy: `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'` which prevents any exfiltration of timing data via injected inline scripts in browser-based attack scenarios.

config.network: CloudFront -> Origin Shield -> ALB (internal) -> ECS tasks (3 AZ)
config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: strip Server-Timing, add CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'
config.alb_rate_limit: 50 req/s per source IP via listener rule with fixed-response 429
